messages:
alex PM: Quick sync — post-launch iteration planning for 1.1. We need to finalize tradeoffs: shipping a small feature set vs clearing top customer bugs. Thoughts?

maria Eng: +1. Can we get a short list of critical bugs? hard to decide without severity/occurrence.

jordan QA: I exported the top 12 failures from last week. Most are race conditions and two embedding regressions from the new tokenizer.

nina Design: From UX side, a fix for conversation context truncation is high impact for demo customers. It's a small UI + prompt tweak.

sam CS: Customer-facing priority: three enterprise customers have reported latency spikes when using long-system prompts. They want a fix before next billing cycle.

leo PMM: Marketing needs at least one visible improvement for the mid-April case studies. Might be easier to highlight stability fixes than a small feature.

maria Eng: Rough dev estimate: race fixes = 3-5 dev-days, tokenizer regressions = 7-10 dev-days, context truncation UX + prompts = 2 dev-days, latency investigation = 4 dev-days.

alex PM: Ok — proposal: spend 60% capacity on high-impact bugs (race + tokenizer + latency) and 40% on two small enhancements (streaming hint and per-route cost breakdown). Agree?

nina Design: 40% for enhancements is fine if we guarantee context truncation is shipped as a bugfix (reads like a regression).

jordan QA: Prioritization note: tokenizer regressions caused failed E2E on 8% of seeded prompts. That blocks a lot of downstream checks.

maria Eng: Can we surface a short rollback plan if tokenizer fix causes perf hit? prefer feature-flag + canary for the tokenizer change.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/tokenizer-fix -> infra-canary-2 at 1779992205

sam CS: If we can get a canary within 48h and communicating status to the three customers, they'll be OK with staged rollout.

ale x PM: Action items: 1) maria + jordan: push tokenizer canary + rollback plan (48h). 2) maria: allocate 3 dev-days to race fixes sprint 2. 3) nina: ship prompt/UX tweak as hotfix this week. 4) leo: update case study messaging to emphasize stability. 5) sam: ping the three enterprise customers with the canary plan.

maria Eng: I'll create the PRs and add canary runbook.

jordan QA: I'll attach the failing seeds and create a short test to run in CI canary.

sam CS: I'll draft the customer note and share here for review.

alex PM: One more thing — let's track impact metrics: embed-failure-rate, tail latency (p99), and demo conversion. If p99 stays under 350ms and embed-fail drops 5x, we mark this iteration a win.

leo PMM: Sounds measurable. Add a dashboard tile for p99 and embed-failure-rate; I can share to sales.

alex PM: Cool. We'll reconvene EOD Friday. If anything blocks earlier, call it out in this thread. :thumbsup:

sam CS: noted. I'll post the customer note by EOD.

maria Eng: starting work now.

deploy-bot: canary completed: tokenizer-fix @ infra-canary-2 (status: partial success) at 1779992238

jordan QA: canary logs show improved embed correctness but slight mem bump on 1 node — investigating.

alex PM: Thanks all. If mem bump persists, prioritize rollback + smaller patch.
